current_behavior: Lower-cases the message and checks English keyword regexes in order tool_request, analysis, code_question, then greeting patterns or any message of at most 40 chars / 6 words without code-like characters as smalltalk, else unknown.

question.instructions: Decide which intent category this operator chat message belongs to, which sets its token budget.

options.smalltalk: Greetings, thanks, acknowledgements (ok, yes, no) and other short social or conversational messages without a technical request.
options.code_question: A question about code or programming: a function, class, method, bug, error or exception, tests, imports, modules, libraries, APIs, SQL, scripts, a programming language or developer tool.
options.tool_request: A request to perform an action with a tool: run/execute/call something, search or fetch, browse or open, create/write/read/delete files, list files, install, deploy, trigger, start/stop/restart, scan.
options.analysis: A request for deeper reasoning: analyze, explain, summarize, review, audit, investigate, diagnose, benchmark, compare, evaluate or assess, deep dive, architecture, refactoring, migration or performance questions.
options.unknown: The message is empty or fits none of the other categories (e.g. a longer general question unrelated to code, tools or analysis).

provenance: single annotator (AI assistant), synthetic paraphrases of Ananta decision situations, not reviewed by a human, evaluation only, never release evidence
